factories.name: new_list_objects_step
factories.description: List one bounded page of a bucket's object keys and common prefixes under an optional prefix and delimiter, in key order, continuing with an opaque continuation token.

inputSchema.description: ListObjectsInput selects one page of a bucket listing. Keys are listed in UTF-8 binary order.

bucket.description: Bucket is the bucket name; blank uses the connection's defaultBucket.

continuationToken.description: ContinuationToken is the NextContinuationToken of the previous page; blank reads the first page.

delimiter.description: Delimiter groups keys that contain it after Prefix into CommonPrefixes, usually "/" to list one folder level; blank lists every key under Prefix.

maxKeys.description: MaxKeys bounds the objects plus common prefixes on the page, from 1 to 1000; zero uses the connection's listPageSize.

prefix.description: Prefix limits the page to keys that begin with it, such as reports/2026/; blank lists every key.

startAfter.description: StartAfter lists only keys after this key; blank starts at the first key.

factories.name: new_head_object_step
factories.description: Read one object's size, ETag, content type, modification time, version, storage class, and user-defined metadata without reading its content.

inputSchema.description: HeadObjectInput identifies the object whose metadata is read.

bucket.description: Bucket is the bucket name; blank uses the connection's defaultBucket.

key.description: Key is the object key, such as reports/2026-09.md.

factories.name: new_get_object_text_step
factories.description: Read one small text object as bounded UTF-8 text, refusing binary, compressed, and oversized objects without returning their content.

inputSchema.description: GetObjectTextInput identifies the object whose text is read.

bucket.description: Bucket is the bucket name; blank uses the connection's defaultBucket.

key.description: Key is the object key, such as reports/2026-09.md.

factories.name: new_put_object_step
factories.description: Store one object from bounded text or bytes with its content type and user-defined metadata, either replacing any object at the key or, in create-only mode, only when the key is free; a repeated attempt of the same Step converges on the same object.

inputSchema.description: PutObjectInput describes one object to store. Set at most one of TextContent and ByteContent; leaving both empty stores an empty object.

bucket.description: Bucket is the bucket name; blank uses the connection's defaultBucket.

byteContent.description: ByteContent is binary content, encoded as base64 in JSON.

contentType.description: ContentType is the media type S3 stores and returns, such as text/markdown; charset=utf-8.

isCreateOnly.description: IsCreateOnly stores the object only when no current object exists at the key, by sending If-None-Match: *; an object that this Step execution did not write selects alreadyExists.

key.description: Key is the object key, such as reports/2026-09.md.

metadata.description: Metadata is user-defined metadata, keyed by lowercase name without the x-amz-meta- prefix, such as report-id. Values are printable ASCII. The dex-idempotency-key name is reserved.
